verdict.rationale: Adyen In-Person Payments offers automation surfaces, such as Management API terminal automation, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. The pack has no evidence of version history, review workflows, or rollback for automations or configurations. Payment refunds are a different feature and are not automation rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
